propositions: The deprecated environment variable REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be removed from the resolver and all live code paths, leaving only the config table key [tool.rebar.llm].model and per-class env vars in place.
A still-set REBAR_LLM_MODEL environment variable must fail loudly with RemovedInputError when LLMConfig.from_env is called, rather than being silently ignored or processed.
The deprecation registry row must be deleted and replaced with a tombstone entry in _deprecations.py that enforces fail-loud behavior for any remaining env exports.

All test files and documentation that reference REBAR_LLM_MODEL as a live configuration channel must be retargeted to [tool.rebar.llm].model, per-class REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_MODEL env vars, or CLI overrides.
Model resolution precedence after removal becomes CLI override > [tool.rebar.llm].model config table > built-in default, with no environment variable channel for the bare model.
The operator-facing runbooks and compose files must be updated to reflect removal rather than deprecation status.
